{{Top|leg}}
'''Gacerite dirge opera''' was a form of [[Opera/Legends|opera]] practiced by the [[Gacerite]]s of [[Gacerian]]. It was rumored that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was fond of Gacerite dirge opera before his [[Death/Legends|death]].
